test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 02 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In which of the following months did the Australian Open take place in 2022?
solution: The correct answer is __**January**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The 2022 Australian Open was a Grand Slam tennis tournament that took place at **Melbourne Park, Australia from 17 to 30 January 2022.** • Australian tennis player **Ashleigh Barty** defeated American Danielle Collins to win the **Australian Open women's title on 29 January 2022.** • **Spain's Rafael Nadal** won the Australian Open Men's Singles final on** 30 January 2022.**
